note: Multi-turn cases for the live tutor (docs/agent/architecture.md, Evals). Every student turn, candidate reply and label was written by claude-opus-5-5 on the operator's delegation, not by a human, and none has been reviewed by a human. Items are bank items; no stem, figure or rubric text from the official corpus appears. Labels cover the deterministic checks that apply to the turn's mode and position (app/evals/agent_checks.py applicable_checks); judge-graded checks are not labelled here. A turn is acceptable exactly when every label is true. The no_dash check has no unacceptable turn here because the set itself may carry no dash; tests/agent/test_screen.py proves that check red on a crafted sentence. Cases with a profile_pair are pairs: the same item, stage, screen and student turns under two profiles that differ in the one field the pair names. The applied case's turns carry a profile_applied label saying whether the reply visibly applies that field, and every deterministic verdict must match across the pair. The two adversarial pairs carry an instruction-shaped student term, which the profile validator drops, and a stated wants_answer request, which is never rendered.
